exams.name: Real Estate Broker Examination
exams.notes: Commission may use a testing service to administer the examination. Exam tests ability to perform services authorized by a broker license and knowledge of general practice for handling real estate transactions.
exams.quote: An applicant shall pass an examination given by the Commission under § 17-306 of this subtitle.

interval_years.quote: Before a license expires, the licensee periodically may renew it for an additional 2–year term

required.quote: To qualify for renewal of a license under this subtitle, a licensee shall complete at least 15 clock hours of continuing education instruction

hours_per_period.quote: a licensee shall complete at least 15 clock hours of continuing education instruction, as provided in subsection (b) of this section, during the preceding 2–year term

value: at least one 3 clock hour course on relevant changes in federal, State, or local laws and regulations, court cases and industry trends
at least one 1.5 clock hour course on federal, State, and local fair housing laws and regulations
at least one 3 clock hour ethics course including Maryland Code of Ethics, flipping, fraudulent real estate practices, and professionalism
at least one 3 clock hour course on principles of real estate brokerage relationships and disclosures
at least one 3 clock hour course on broker supervision (for broker license renewals and branch office managers/team leaders)
topical_requirements.quote: the subject matter approved by the Commission shall: (ii) every 2 years, include at least one 3 clock hour course that outlines relevant changes...fair housing laws and regulations...ethics course...principles of real estate brokerage relationships...broker supervision

available.quote: the Commission may issue a reciprocal license to a person: (1) holding a current license to provide real estate brokerage services issued by another state

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current out-of-state license, have principal place of business outside Maryland, file application with Commission, provide certified copy or certified statement of current out-of-state license, submit disciplinary history, attest to no pending discipline or disqualifying convictions, agree to be bound by Maryland law and Code of Ethics, pay required fees, and submit consent to service of process.
requirements.quote: the Commission shall issue a reciprocal license to an applicant licensed in another state to provide real estate brokerage services if: (1) the applicant files with the Commission an application for a reciprocal license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively obtaining or using a license for oneself or another
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraudulently or deceptively obtains or attempts to obtain a license for the applicant or licensee or for another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making a misrepresentation or knowingly making a false promise
disciplinary_grounds.quote: directly or through another person willfully makes a misrepresentation or knowingly makes a false promise

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally or negligently failing to disclose a known or knowable material fact about the property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: intentionally or negligently fails to disclose to any person with whom the applicant or licensee deals a material fact that the licensee knows or should know and that relates to the property with which the licensee or applicant deals

disciplinary_grounds.description: Associate broker or salesperson providing services on behalf of a broker without informing other affiliated brokers in writing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: as an associate real estate broker or a real estate salesperson, provides or attempts to provide real estate brokerage services on behalf of a real estate broker without informing in writing any other real estate broker with whom the associate real estate broker or the real estate salesperson is affiliated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Retaining or attempting to retain an unlicensed individual as associate broker or salesperson to evade commission prohibition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: retains or attempts to retain the services of any unlicensed individual as an associate real estate broker or a real estate salesperson to evade the law prohibiting payment of a commission to an unlicensed individual

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guaranteeing or allowing another to guarantee future profits from resale of real property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: guarantees or authorizes or allows another person to guarantee future profits from the resale of real property

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting, selling, or offering to sell real property by offering prizes, free lots, lotteries, or false free appraisal advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: solicits, sells, or offers to sell real property, so as to influence or attempt to influence a prospective party to the sale of real property, by: (i) offering a prize or a free lot; (ii) conducting a lottery or contest

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting a listing contract without a definite automatic termination date
disciplinary_grounds.quote: accepts a listing contract to sell real property that fails to provide a definite termination date that is effective automatically without notice from the buyer or the seller

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting a net listing contract that leaves the licensee free to sell at any price above the net price
disciplinary_grounds.quote: accepts a listing contract to sell real property that provides for a "net" return to a seller and leaves the licensee free to sell the real property at any price higher than the "net" price

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly soliciting a party to an exclusive listing to terminate that contract and enter a new one with the soliciting licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: knowingly solicits a party to an exclusive listing contract with another licensee to terminate that contract and enter a new contract with the licensee making the solicitation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting a party to a sales contract, lease, or agreement to breach it for the purpose of substituting a new contract with the soliciting licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: solicits a party to a sales contract, lease, or agreement that was negotiated by another to breach the contract, lease, or agreement for the purpose of substituting a new contract

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to promptly furnish each party copies of listing contracts, sales contracts, or lease agreements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: for any transaction in which the licensee has served as or on behalf of a real estate broker, fails to furnish promptly to each party to the transaction a copy of: (i) the listing contract to sell or rent real property; (ii) the contract of sale; or (iii) the lease agreement

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep copies of executed listing contracts, sales contracts, or lease agreements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: for any transaction in which the licensee has served as or on behalf of a real estate broker, fails to keep a copy of any executed: (i) listing contract to sell or rent real property; (ii) contract of sale; or (iii) lease agreement

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly inducing or discouraging real estate transfers based on race, color, religion, sex, handicap, familial status, or national origin
disciplinary_grounds.quote: whether or not acting for monetary gain, knowingly induces or attempts to induce a person to transfer real estate or discourages or attempts to discourage a person from buying real estate: (i) by making representations about the existing or potential proximity of real property owned or used by individuals of a particular race, color, religion, sex, handicap, familial status, or national origin

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using contract forms or advertising that includes the name of an organization of which the licensee is not a member
disciplinary_grounds.quote: uses any of the following material if it includes the name of an organization or association of which the licensee is not a member: (i) a contract form for the listing of real property for sale, rent, or exchange

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising sale or rent of real property without disclosing the advertiser's name and licensee status
disciplinary_grounds.quote: as a real estate broker, an associate real estate broker, or a real estate salesperson, advertises the sale or rent of or an offer to buy real property while failing to disclose in the advertisement the name of the advertiser and the fact that the advertiser is a real estate broker

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising in any misleading or untruthful manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: advertises in any misleading or untruthful manner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Associate broker or salesperson advertising without disclosing the name of the broker on whose behalf they act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: as a licensed associate real estate broker or a licensed real estate salesperson, advertises the sale or rent of or an offer to buy real property in the name of the associate broker or the salesperson while failing to disclose in the advertisement the name of the real estate broker on behalf of whom the associate broker or the salesperson is acting

disciplinary_grounds.description: Associate broker or salesperson accepting commission or valuable consideration from any person other than their affiliated broker
disciplinary_grounds.quote: except as provided under § 17–604 of this title, for real estate brokerage services provided by an associate real estate broker or a real estate salesperson, accepts a commission or other valuable consideration from any person other than a real estate broker with whom the associate broker or the salesperson is affiliated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to account for or promptly remit money held for another person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to account for or to remit promptly any money that comes into the possession of the licensee but belongs to another person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying or receiving rebates, profits, compensation, or commissions in violation of the title
disciplinary_grounds.quote: pays or receives a rebate, profit, compensation, or commission in violation of any provision of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony, a directly related misdemeanor, or a crime constituting a violation of the title
disciplinary_grounds.quote: under the laws of the United States or of any state, is convicted of: (i) a felony; (ii) a misdemeanor that is directly related to the fitness and qualification of the applicant or licensee to provide real estate brokerage services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct demonstrating bad faith, incompetency, untrustworthiness, dishonesty, fraud, or improper dealings
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engages in conduct that demonstrates bad faith, incompetency, or untrustworthiness or that constitutes dishonest, fraudulent, or improper dealings

disciplinary_grounds.description: With actual knowledge, associating with a licensee in a transaction that violates the title
disciplinary_grounds.quote: with actual knowledge of the violation, associates with a licensee in a transaction or practice that violates any provision of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: As a broker, failing to exercise reasonable and adequate supervision over brokerage services by others on behalf of the broker
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violates § 17–320(c) of this subtitle by failing as a real estate broker to exercise reasonable and adequate supervision over the provision of real estate brokerage services by another individual on behalf of the broker

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing a contract without required notice of buyer's right of selection of title/settlement/escrow services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: provides to a party a contract that does not contain a notice of the buyer's right of selection, as required by § 17–524 of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Requiring a buyer to employ a particular title, settlement, or escrow company or title lawyer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: requires a buyer to employ a particular title insurance company, settlement company, escrow company, or title lawyer in violation of § 17–607 of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to make the disclosure or provide the consent form required by § 17-530.2
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to make the disclosure or provide the consent form required by § 17–530.2 of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of Subtitle 5 relating to trust money
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violates any provision of Subtitle 5 of this title that relates to trust money

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any other provision of the title, any regulation, or the code of ethics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violates any other provision of this title; violates any regulation adopted under this title or any provision of the code of ethics

disciplinary_grounds.description: As branch office manager, failing to exercise reasonable and adequate supervision over brokerage services by salespersons and associate brokers at the office
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violates § 17–320(d) of this subtitle by failing as a branch office manager to exercise reasonable and adequate supervision over the provision of real estate brokerage services by any salesperson or associate broker registered with that office

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been disciplined under a real estate licensing law of another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has been disciplined under a real estate licensing law of another jurisdiction

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A licensed real estate broker shall obtain a branch office certificate before the broker may maintain a branch office in the State.

definition_quote.value: "Provide real estate brokerage services" means to engage in any of the following activities: (1) for consideration, providing any of the following services for another person: (i) selling, buying, exchanging, or leasing any real estate; or (ii) collecting rent for the use of any real estate; (2) for consideration, assisting another person to locate or obtain for purchase or lease any residential real estate; (3) engaging regularly in a business of dealing in real estate or leases or options on real estate; (4) engaging in a business the primary purpose of which is promoting the sale of real estate through a listing in a publication issued primarily for the promotion of real estate sales; (5) engaging in a business that subdivides land that is located in any state and sells the divided lots; or (6) for consideration, serving as a consultant regarding any activity set forth in items (1) through (5) of this subsection.
definition_quote.quote: "Provide real estate brokerage services" means to engage in any of the following activities: (1) for consideration, providing any of the following services for another person: (i) selling, buying, exchanging, or leasing any real estate; or (ii) collecting rent for the use of any real estate

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: If a licensed real estate broker obtains the written informed consent of all parties to a real estate transaction, the real estate broker, or a branch office manager described in § 17–518(d) of this subtitle who has been designated by the licensed real estate broker, may act as a dual agent

designated_agency_permitted.quote: The dual agent in a real estate transaction shall assign a licensed associate real estate broker or licensed real estate salesperson affiliated with the real estate broker to act as the intra–company agent on behalf of the seller or lessor and another licensed associate real estate broker or licensed real estate salesperson affiliated with the real estate broker to act as the intra–company agent on behalf of the buyer or lessee.

transaction_licensee_role_permitted.quote: "Subagent" means a licensed real estate broker, licensed associate real estate broker, or licensed real estate salesperson who: ... (3) has a brokerage relationship with the seller or lessor; and (4) assists a prospective buyer or lessee in the acquisition of real estate for sale or for lease in a nonagency capacity.

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: the disclosure shall occur not later than the first scheduled face–to–face contact with the seller or lessor or the buyer or lessee

written_service_agreement_required.quote: "Brokerage relationship" means a relationship under a brokerage agreement between a client and a broker who has been authorized by the client to provide real estate brokerage services in a residential real estate transaction.

sales_contract_mandatory_disclosures.quote: Each real estate contract submitted to a party by a real estate broker, an associate real estate broker, or a real estate salesperson for use in the sale of a single-family dwelling shall contain, in bold-faced type, a statement that the buyer has the right to select the buyer's own

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: accepts a listing contract to sell real property that fails to provide a definite termination date that is effective automatically without notice from the buyer or the seller

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: A licensee shall keep the records required by this section for 5 years, starting on the date of the closing of a real estate transaction, or, if the transaction is not closed, 5 years after the date of the listing.

escrow_account_required.quote: a real estate broker promptly, but not more than 7 business days after the acceptance of a contract of sale by both parties, shall deposit trust money in an account that is maintained by the real estate broker: (i) separately from the real estate broker's own accounts; and (ii) solely for trust money.

escrow_deposit_deadline_business_days.quote: a real estate broker promptly, but not more than 7 business days after the acceptance of a contract of sale by both parties, shall deposit trust money in an account

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: shall deposit trust money in an account that is maintained by the real estate broker: (i) separately from the real estate broker's own accounts; and (ii) solely for trust money

fixed_office_required.quote: Each licensed real estate broker who is a resident of the State shall maintain an office in the State.

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: If the licensed real estate broker designates another individual as a branch office manager, the manager shall be: (i) a licensed associate real estate broker; (ii) a licensed real estate salesperson who has at least 3 years' experience providing real estate brokerage services

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Commission as an associate real estate broker or a real estate salesperson before the individual, while acting on behalf of a real estate broker, may provide real estate brokerage services in the State

qualified_association_permitted.quote: A licensed real estate salesperson or a licensed associate real estate broker who is a shareholder of a professional service corporation, a member of a limited liability company, or the owner of any other business entity may direct that any commission due the salesperson or associate broker be paid to the corporation, limited liability company, or other business entity.

recovery_fund_exists.quote: The Commission shall: (1) establish a Real Estate Guaranty Fund; and (2) maintain the Guaranty Fund at a level of at least $250,000.

recovery_fund_max_per_claim.quote: The amount recovered for any claim against the Guaranty Fund may not exceed $50,000 for each claim.
